data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported an unfavourable prior-year run-off deviation of GBP 4.7m (a strengthening of reserves), wholly relating to reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and prior whole account quota share business with Syndicate 2003. The 2017 underwriting performance was further adversely affected by a softening market and a number of major 2017 catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California wildfires). The prior-year strengthening is relatively small versus opening gross claims outstanding and relates to older underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavourable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 4.7m (2016: favorable run-off deviation of GBP 2.5m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

The underwriting performance in 2017 was driven by the continuous softening of the rates across the portfolio in the market. The high incidence and magnitude of claims from natural catastrophes in the second half of 2017 such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California Wildfires added to the adverse performance.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) 2016 comparative column. Prior-year movement sourced from Note 5 narrative which reports an unfavourable run-off deviation of GBP 4.7m (assumed to be a gross amount as described in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note). No gross per-LOB prior-year movement breakdown provided; LOB-level directions inferred. A gross claims development triangle is present and has been captured in _claims_triangle for cross-checks. Settlement of the 2014 year of account is noted in the P&L footnote (gross GBP 76.9k, ceded GBP 8.8k) and may distort calendar-year movements.
